query: How do I reset my password?
instruction: Given a question, retrieve relevant passages from the document collection that answer it

matches.text: Reset your account password If you cannot sign in because you forgot your password, open the sign-in page and choose Forgot password. Enter the email address registered to your account. Follow the password reset link sent to that mailbox and choose a new password. The link expires after thirty minutes. If you cannot access the registered mailbox or your two-factor authentication device, contact the workspace administrator. Never share passwords or verification codes in a support message.
